basics.name: Felipe Peñaloza Oyarzún
basics.label: Full Stack Developer with over 5 years of experience
basics.summary: I am a Web Developer focused on creating functional and user-centric applications. During my 5+ years of experience, I have acquired practical knowledge in Front-End (JavaScript, React, HTML, CSS), participating in the optimization of payment flows and transactional platforms. Currently, I am expanding my experience towards the Back-End (Java, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL) through my Computer Systems Analysis studies at DUOC UC, which gives me a more complete understanding of the software development lifecycle.
basics.cvSummary: Full-Stack Developer with over 5 years of experience building production interfaces and collaborating on the services that support them. I have practical knowledge in modern JavaScript (React, Astro), HTML5 and CSS3, and applied experience in integrating payment gateways and validating transactional flows (Sencillito.com). Additionally, I possess backend knowledge using Java, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL and Oracle PL/SQL, which I continue to deepen in my Computer Systems Analysis studies at DUOC UC. I am interested in participating in the full development lifecycle: from the SQL query to the accessible on-screen component.
